[LIMP.13.3] **Two programs share a schema by its own name.** A fact crosses
between tiers only where each holds a schema of that own name ([RFCS.23.3]): each
imports one library under one path, or each declares the `NAME` in the file it
compiles. A `Reply` one program declares and a `lib.Reply` another imports are
two schemas, however alike their slots, and the receiver refuses the record.
